Why are these Dispose calls needed? What is the cause of the leak mentioned in the issue?

> Why are these Dispose calls needed? What is the cause of the leak mentioned in the issue?

The leak mentioned in the issue is not really a leak. The `ProcessThread` type contains no unmanaged resources of any kind, but it derives from `Component` which implements a finalizer. The user has observed some instances of this type most probably because they were rooted by the finalizer queue.

By calling `Component.Dispose` we call `GC.SuppressFinalize` which fixes this. 

But is this really a problem that instances of `ProcessThread` need two GC Collections to be freed?
I would  say no, but #40281 tells me that it can be issue for some of our users.

@stephentoub what do you think?
